info.title: Advent calendar API
info.description: Backend username/password accounts, user management and owner-only calendar administration. Recipient viewing and timed opening are deferred.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Fixed-expiry cookie sessions and CSRF exchange

tags.name: users
tags.description: Authorized account administration; no API superadmin provisioning

post.summary: Create an owned calendar for an assigned calendar user

201.description: Persisted calendar with exactly 24 empty doors

get.summary: List only calendars owned by the current calendar administrator
Retrieve owner-only administration and preview content

200.description: Privileged owner content; never a recipient response

get.summary: Check migration completion and current database availability
Obtain a fresh principal-bound CSRF token

post.summary: Log in; temporary credentials grant only password setup
Refresh current administrator verification for five minutes
Revoke only this session and clear its cookie
Verify current password, replace it and revoke every session
Create an account with a 30-minute temporary password; recent administrator verification required

get.summary: List public account metadata with SQL-enforced scope

post.summary: Issue a different temporary password for an authorized nonsuperadmin target

patch.summary: Superadmin role transition; promotion replaces the credential atomically

put.summary: Save plain-text content on one numbered door
Persist chronological order or a newly generated random permutation

BadRequest.description: Invalid body, UUID, or normalized title

UnsupportedMediaType.description: A JSON request body is required

Unauthorized.description: Invalid credentials, session or expired temporary password; login does not disclose account existence.

Forbidden.description: Insufficient authority, restricted session, invalid CSRF exchange or missing recent verification.

Conflict.description: Reserved username, stale verified state, unchanged replacement password or role/responsibility conflict.

Unavailable.description: Session validity persistence unavailable; access fails closed.

title.description: Trim surrounding .NET Unicode whitespace before validation/storage. The trimmed value must contain 1-100 Unicode code points and no NUL (PostgreSQL text cannot store NUL). Combining marks and compound emoji components each count separately. Raw input has no minLength/maxLength so surrounding whitespace never invalidates a valid normalized title.

verificationRequired.description: True only when an otherwise authorized administrator must reauthenticate before retrying a sensitive operation. Other forbidden responses must not be treated as verification expiry.

requestToken.description: Framework request token; use only in the designated protected exchange.

password.description: Write-only secret; never trimmed/truncated. 8-128 Unicode code points (15 minimum for either administrator role), uppercase, lowercase and punctuation/symbol; local common-password rejection.

responsibleAdministratorId.description: Required for superadmin-created ordinary users; forbidden for calendaradmin creators and administrator accounts.

name.description: Single display name. Trim surrounding .NET Unicode whitespace; require 1-100 Unicode code points after trimming, including internal spaces. No NUL or invalid Unicode. Names need not be unique.

enabled.description: Required; null and missing are rejected.

temporaryPassword.description: Required on promotion; must differ from current credential and meet administrator policy.

responsibleAdministratorId.description: Required on first demotion; an existing association cannot be replaced.

totalCount.description: Total accounts visible to the authorized caller, before pagination.

AuthCookie.name: advent.auth
AuthCookie.description: Backend-owned HttpOnly host-only persistent cookie. Fixed expiry; Secure outside Development/Testing.

Antiforgery.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
Antiforgery.description: ASP.NET token from GET /auth/csrf, paired with the distinct advent.csrf host-only cookie. Required even for login.
